mockExams.title: GCE A Level mock — Physics (paper 1)
mockExams.instructions: Answer all questions. Section A has four short multiple-choice questions (2 marks each); Section B has three structured questions (4 marks each). The paper is marked out of 20. Constants: e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m/s, ln 2 = 0.693. This is an original practice paper; its format is not that of the Cameroon GCE Board and should be checked against the official texts.
